posts.title: Nepal Days
posts.description: My college buddy has been trying to get me to visit Nepal for two decades now. It seemed like I would get there earlier, but I did not. When we caught up a year ago, I swore up and down that I would go see him once I could travel again... and I finally made it. A few photos from that trip to Kathmandu and Pokhara, October 2026.
